appSource.buildNote: Signed root universal APK built from the committed app source at appSource.commit.

notes: One ARM64 dual-entry effect driver supports the embedded AIDL Effect V4 interface and the legacy AELI factory entry.
Global Binder control is ldsp.control protocol 3. Audio effect UUIDs remain unchanged for effect attachment compatibility.
Android factory, Binder authorization, audio processing, and device compatibility remain unverified for this build.

Module test 18 embedded root universal app 1.7.1-mixers-test-17/code 106. That prototype targeted Volume Manager persistence across long suspensions and helper-loss recovery with bounded backoff; device validation remained pending.

App test 23 adds bounded pre-start preparation for scoped opt-in AAudio streams through the existing coverage controller. Binder UID/session matching, independent topology and duplicate/global-output guards, original IPC deadlines and never-started cleanup remain mandatory. May delay stream opening by up to 2.2 seconds. JL Mod audible results remain device-unverified; driver and ldspctl unchanged.

App test 24 corrects AudioFlinger track parsing for unrelated fast/shared rows such as Type F1 S. These rows remain ineligible for session DSP; a confirmed normal PCM track is still covered. A regression test proves the previously captured layout is accepted without weakening the active-fast-track exclusion. Preparation failures now log a bounded phase, root exception class, and fixed category without exposing exception messages or paths. The user confirmed CompatibilityPreparationProvider and its authority are registered; the only reported provider error was an unrelated Huawei authority. JL Mod preparation failure remains unresolved pending the new diagnostic and runtime testing. Root unit tests: 506 passed; no device validation.

Module test 26 requests the official Package Manager --force-queryable install override for LightningDSP only on Android 11+. Live Pixel capture repeatedly reported provider_unresolved before short JL Mod streams; session effects were created only after playback began. This targets caller-side package visibility without granting QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES to emulators or changing exported provider methods, Binder UID/session verification, opt-in, deadlines or duplicate-effect guards. Signed APK, driver and helper are reused unchanged. Runtime resolution and audible distortion remain unverified with this installer change.

Module test 27 embeds app test 25/code 114: Session Mode reports verified playback rather than retained engine ownership; explicitly idle engines are bypassed immediately, ordinary-mode ownership can resume on fresh playback, and activity observation is independent of optional session discovery. AudioService player states and validated empty-vs-unavailable collection are handled separately. Global-to-Session removes session zero. Provider visibility installer fix from test 26 retained. 519 root tests passed; rootless/plugin Kotlin compiled; on-device pause/resume and vendor layout compatibility remain unverified. Driver/helper unchanged.

Module test 28 embeds signed root universal app test 26/code 115 from committed source 58ed9f200596d3f712d2eb3dd713fcaeb8d7399b. Adds a separate default-off Reuse AAudio session option beneath Improve app compatibility. In selected Vector/LSPosed processes only, the first successful eligible AAudio stream pins an allocated session ID and later streams that requested NONE reuse it, avoiding repeated session preparation for short sounds. Explicit app session IDs are untouched; failed reuse clears the pinned ID and retries once with the original request. Existing LOW_LATENCY-to-NONE compatibility remains separate and required. Root tests, native hook host tests and all four ABI release build completed; real JL Mod behavior, session policy, latency and audio stability remain device-unverified. Native driver/helper unchanged; Actions artifact only, not a prerelease.

Module test 29 embeds signed root universal app test 27/code 116 from committed source bf270aa574f127e272129bb1060e8ccdeaff4681. Fixes an eligibility gap: AAudio defaults a builder to SESSION_ID_NONE when the app never calls setSessionId, but test 28 only treated an explicit setter call as eligible, so common app streams did not enter session reuse. The default-off reuse path now recognizes the documented default, allocates/pins its first successful session and reuses it for subsequent eligible streams. Direct setter imports are observed through an optional safe GOT transaction; if a present import cannot be safely observed, reuse is disabled for that process, protecting app-specified IDs. Legacy pre-start allocation remains restricted to explicit setter callers unless reuse is separately opted in. Host regressions cover implicit-default reuse, optional imports and explicit IDs; root tests and all four ABI native compilation passed. Short-sound audibility, latency and JL Mod behavior remain device-unverified. Native driver/helper unchanged; Actions artifact only, not a prerelease.

Module test 30 embeds signed root universal app 1.7.1-mixers-test-28/code 117 from committed source 9bf38e85efd7f9ca3b6bf4e772e7016367adbc31. Runtime capture showed Vector injecting AudioCompatibilityHook and registering the native observer in both the launcher and JL Mod :midlet process, while libmmapi_eas.so/liboboe.so were mapped and short sounds kept receiving new session IDs. The observer had no AAudio imports rebound. The app now sweeps already-loaded app DSOs immediately and retries every two seconds until AAudio imports are actually patched; readiness is tracked separately from OpenSL. The sweep runs on a daemon worker, does not inspect or modify PCM callbacks, and remains limited to explicitly scoped apps with the compatibility property enabled. Native AAudio/GOT/OpenSL host tests, root unit tests, and native release builds for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64 passed. The phone was disconnected before runtime validation, so glitch-free playback and JL Mod short-sound behavior remain unverified. Driver/helper unchanged; Actions artifact only, not a prerelease.

Module test 31 embeds signed root universal app 1.7.1-samsung-volume-test-29/code 118 from committed source a1e61de52e3376d38b5f921b6ab5df4d19bc3892. For Samsung One UI, a SystemUI Xposed hook clears only FLAG_SHOW_UI in VolumeDialogControl.onVolumeChangedW while the root Volume Manager refreshes a short-lived lease. The existing root controller still opens LightningDSP UI; lease expiry and bridge shutdown restore native behavior. The manifest scopes the hook to SystemUI in addition to the framework. Root unit tests and app release compilation passed; no Samsung device runtime test has yet validated class/method resolution, Xposed scope activation, or panel suppression. Driver/helper unchanged; Actions artifact only, not a prerelease.

Module test 32 embeds signed root universal app 1.7.1-armsx2-audio-test-30/code 119 from committed source 243322cca963084189320c2f92ca1dbf03703795. ARMSX2 source configures Oboe for AAudio LowLatency and statically links Oboe into libemucore_4k.so or libemucore_16k.so; its loader resolves AAudio symbols with dlsym. The opt-in compatibility observer now permits these two app-local sonames and wraps only matching AAudio symbols/addresses, rewriting the low-latency request through the established compatibility path. Host AAudio/GOT sanitizer tests, 522 root unit tests, and signed universal release assembly passed. Device stream interception, output routing, latency, and audible DSP remain unverified. Driver/helper unchanged; Actions artifact only, not a prerelease.

Module test 33 includes the Samsung One UI controller class correction inspired by PR 1, guarded by Samsung manufacturer and foreground bypass. Rapid foreground transitions and device behavior are unverified. Receipt sync failure handling remains unchanged. Driver and helper unchanged.

Module test 34 embeds signed root universal app 1.7.1-unified-session-test-32/code 121. For the opt-in eligible process-local AAudio unified session, Session Mode retains an effect between bursts only while its UID/session/player and bounded verified process lease remain valid. Active playback visibility and global coverage remain separate. The effect can be removed when the player disappears; first-sound delay, Binder lifecycle and audible continuity require device testing. Driver/helper unchanged.

Module test 35 embeds signed root universal app 1.7.1-focused-session-test-33/code 122. Fixes Binder owner proof ACK PID and adds opt-in Session Mode focused-window retention for eligible, independently verified unified AAudio sessions. Focus and playback visibility remain separate; Global Mode is not changed. Session disappearance, missed focus loss, multi-process window focus, Binder runtime and audible continuity remain unverified on device. Driver/helper unchanged.

Module test 36 embeds signed root universal app 1.7.1-focused-session-test-34/code 123 from committed source 3aea6515cd480198ebeeb967a230b80123b41dcc. Package visibility for the Vector compatibility provider is declared queryable without adding broad package permissions. Focus/owner lease reports use a bounded control worker independent from stream pre-start preparation, preventing a blocked preparation from starving focus updates. Session Mode active processing now includes only currently playing sessions or sessions retained by verified focused-session policy, with user opt-in and per-app DSP state required. Global Mode and native driver/helper are unchanged. Root unit tests: 543 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; signed universal APK and manifest verified. Android runtime provider resolution, JL Mod session timing, notification visibility and audible continuity remain device-unverified.

Module test 37 embeds signed root universal app 1.7.1-focused-session-test-35/code 124 from committed source 4d51df6e4655e42b9303b4b406490b7483f151fc. Adds the default-off Session Mode option Keep effects ready directly after Media session scanning. It retains already-known session effects while the owning app is foregrounded or has active media controls, independently of AAudio compatibility or Vector app selection; grants Usage Access through root when needed and preserves per-app DSP gates. No session IDs are fabricated, and Global Mode plus native driver/helper remain unchanged. Root unit tests: 545 passed; rootless/plugin main Kotlin compilation and signed universal APK assembly passed. Focus transitions, media-session discovery, retention cleanup, battery impact and audible continuity remain device-unverified.
